title: spec taxonomy: respell the seven hyphenated facet values as identifiers (customer_service, supply_chain, …) before release, so a select can carry them
body:
repo:cloud#3 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjRhUZjdy8VXs6Kkur2
Ruled: maintainer 「spec 改成下划线（推荐）」 (repo:cloud#3 seat session `session_01Q4EjjRhUZjdy8VXs6Kkur2`, 2026-11-07)

Filing gate: **maintainer ruling** on a contract gap measured by the objectstack-ai/cloud#3661 dev (PR objectstack-ai/cloud#3689). **Release-gating:** the next CLI release is already held on cloud#3661 (「等 cloud 上线再发 CLI（推荐）」, #30904), and this respell must ship in the same release.

## 维护者速读

#30980 定义的市场分类里，有 7 个值带连字符（例如 customer-service、real-estate-construction），而平台规定下拉选项的值只能用小写字母、数字、下划线和点，所以 cloud 没法把「职能」「行业」做成带选项的下拉。按你的裁决，趁还没发版，把这 7 个值改成下划线写法。

## Measured (objectstack `90523379`)

- 7 of 21 taxonomy values fail `SystemIdentifierSchema` (`^[a-z][a-z0-9_.]*$`), which is `SelectOptionSchema.value`: `customer-service`, `supply-chain`, `trade-distribution`, `professional-services`, `financial-services`, `public-sector`, `real-estate-construction`.
- `ObjectSchema.safeParse` refuses `customer-service` as a select option value. That parse runs at the metadata save door and in `os validate`.

## Expected

- In `packages/spec/src/marketplace/taxonomy.zod.ts`, respell the seven values with underscores. Follow in the same PR:
  - `LEGACY_CATEGORY_MAPPING`;
  - the three connector manifests and the scenario cards (`docs/qa/scenarios/*.json`) that carry them;
  - the CLI publish path and its tests;
  - generated docs and reference pages; the liveness ledger.
- The values are unreleased (#30980 merged `468e0c16`, and no release has carried it), so this is a correction inside the same unreleased narrowing, not a new retirement. State the declaration lines accordingly and let Check Changeset judge.
- Add a guard test: every taxonomy enum value parses as `SystemIdentifierSchema`, so a future value cannot reintroduce the gap.

## Acceptance

- Spec, CLI, scenarios and connector suites green; the guard test fails if a value contains `-`.
- objectstack-ai/cloud#3661's follow-up then moves the pin and turns `business_functions` / `industries` into selects with options and translations.

Serial: before the next objectstack release. The console card #31011 keys its labels by `.options`, so it follows this card.

Suggested-grade: p1.
